<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What is Tako?</h2><a id="user-content-what-is-tako" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What is Tako?" href="#what-is-tako"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Tako is a harness-engineered agentic system for Okta, built to make identity work feel a lot more natural. You ask a question in plain English, and Tako figures out the best way to answer it, whether that means using synced data, calling the API, running a special tool, or building on something you already asked.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>New in v3.0-beta: Harness the Vibe</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>🧭 <strong>Dynamic Agent Routing</strong> - A supervisor-led control plane now routes each turn across SQL Discovery, API Discovery, Special Tools, Result Analysis, and Synthesis instead of forcing every request through a fixed chain.</li>
<li>🧠 <strong>Multi-Turn Conversation</strong> - Session-scoped runtime state and persisted result-set references let follow-up turns reuse prior artifacts, preserve anchored context, and continue the same investigation without rediscovery.</li>
<li>✨ <strong>UI Overhaul</strong> - The interface was rebuilt around wider markdown, cleaner tables, clearer progress updates, and more readable synthesis output for longer multi-step workflows.</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><strong>Harness Engineering for Agentic Systems</strong></h3><a id="user-content-harness-engineering-for-agentic-systems" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Harness Engineering for Agentic Systems" href="#harness-engineering-for-agentic-systems"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Tako now does a better job of choosing how to answer each request. Instead of always following the same path, it looks at the question, the available context, and any earlier results before deciding what to do next.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto"><strong>Self-Healing Code</strong></h3><a id="user-content-self-healing-code" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Self-Healing Code" href="#self-healing-code"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Tako auto-corrects syntax errors, validates API parameters against Okta's spec, and retries intelligently when issues occur. Built-in circuit breakers prevent runaway loops, while automatic error tracking reports exactly what failed and why - eliminating trial-and-error cycles.</p>

<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Supervisor</strong> - Dynamic control plane for turn-by-turn routing and completion decisions</li>
<li><strong>SQL Discovery</strong> - Pulls grounded evidence from the synced SQLite dataset</li>
<li><strong>API Discovery</strong> - Fetches live Okta data when SQL is insufficient or real-time answers are required</li>
<li><strong>Special Tools</strong> - Runs targeted workflows such as access analysis and login-risk analysis</li>
<li><strong>Result Analysis</strong> - Interprets prior artifacts and anchored follow-up scope for multi-turn conversations</li>
<li><strong>Synthesis</strong> - Produces final markdown, scripts, and portable outputs from validated artifacts</li>
<li><strong>Router Agent Retired</strong> - The legacy Router agent has been deprecated in favor of supervisor-led dynamic routing</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto"><strong>Use Cases:</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Cron Jobs</strong> - Schedule daily/weekly reports or data syncs</li>
<li><strong>Scheduled Tasks</strong> - Automate compliance checks and audits</li>
<li><strong>Script Generation</strong> - Generate portable Python scripts for recurring queries</li>
<li><strong>CI/CD Integration</strong> - Embed Okta data validation in pipelines</li>
<li><strong>Batch Processing</strong> - Process large datasets without UI interaction</li>
